## Customer Data Rights  
### Right to Access
**Customer Request:** "I want to see all data you have on me"
**Your Action:**
- Acknowledge request
- Send to Data Protection Officer (dpo@firstuk.bank)
- DPO responds within 30 days with all data
name: Chunk 22/61

raw_entities.name: Customer Data Access Request Compliance Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must acknowledge customer requests to access personal data and escalate to the Data Protection Officer within the required timeframe. The DPO is responsible for responding with all held data within 30 days of the customer request.
context: I want to see all data you have on me
DPO responds within 30 days with all data

raw_entities.name: Data Protection Officer Escalation Duty
raw_entities.description: All customer data access requests must be escalated to the Data Protection Officer at dpo@firstuk.bank for processing and response. This is a mandatory escalation pathway for subject access requests.
context: DPO responds within 30 days with all data

raw_entities.name: Data Access Response Timeframe Obligation
raw_entities.description: The Data Protection Officer must respond to customer data access requests within 30 days, providing all personal data held by the bank on the requesting customer.
context: DPO responds within 30 days with all data

raw_entities.name: Customer Data Access Request Acknowledgement Obligation
raw_entities.description: Staff must acknowledge receipt of customer data access requests as the first step in the compliance process before escalation to the Data Protection Officer.

raw_entities.name: Customer Requesting Data Access
raw_entities.description: A customer exercising their right to access personal data held by the bank. The customer initiates the request by stating they want to see all data the bank holds on them.
context: I want to see all data you have on me
